question: How far can the promoted Recipe-v3 improve when trained from scratch on substantially more unique data under the fixed <=50M parameter constraint?
hypothesis: EXP-012 remained validation-data-limited at its 2.4B endpoint. A fresh cosine schedule designed for a 7.2B horizon should lower held-out General/Edu NLL without changing architecture, optimizer, tokenizer, or source mixture.

data.construction: deterministic rebuild from stream zero unless and until extension equivalence is proven
data.extension_decision: rejected: EXP-012 did not serialize live global document-dedup, source cursor/shard position, mixture deficit, or RNG continuation state

validation.required_benchmarks: embargoed until checkpoint selection is frozen

checkpoint_selection_rule: Default terminal 7.2B. From 4.8B onward, choose the candidate with lowest Combined=(General+Edu)/2; if candidates differ by <=0.003 NLL, prefer the later checkpoint. Required benchmark results cannot participate.
technical_stop_rule: Stop for non-finite state, corrupted data/cursor/hash mismatch, checkpoint corruption, unrecoverable CUDA/driver fault, hardware safety, or duplicate trainer. After 4.8B, stop for human review only if Combined is >=0.020 worse at two consecutive scheduled validations with no evaluator/data anomaly.

operational_controls_not_scientific.thermal_qualification: 30-minute production-shaped soak before final launch; may use fixed 0.5 seconds only if 0.3 is unsafe, then hold fixed for production
operational_controls_not_scientific.external: OMEN Balanced, Turbo/Boost off, AC maximum processor state 60%, AC power, OMEN AUTO fans; human/system evidence recorded without assigning individual causal credit.

source_commit: Recorded after the preregistration commit in builder and run artifacts; no self-referential commit field.
result: No data build or EXP-020 training result exists at preregistration.
